user.title: Set up a panel
user.description: Install ha-paneld on a new panel or connect a panel that is already running it.

menu_option_descriptions.install_or_upgrade: Use Android Debug Bridge (ADB) to inspect a panel where ha-paneld is not installed.
menu_option_descriptions.connect_existing: Add a healthy installation. A later integration version will manage updates after connection.

install_or_upgrade.title: Install ha-paneld
install_or_upgrade.description: Enter the hostname or IP address of the Android panel. Home Assistant will check for an existing installation before using ADB. If the panel asks, you must physically approve this Home Assistant instance. This development preview does not download or install the APK.

connect_existing.title: Connect an existing panel
connect_existing.description: Enter the hostname or IP address of a panel already running ha-paneld.

confirm_existing.title: ha-paneld is already installed
confirm_existing.description: A healthy ha-paneld {version} installation was found at {address}. Submit to connect it to Home Assistant. A later integration version will add update management. No installation will be performed.

authorize_adb.title: Authorize Home Assistant on the panel
authorize_adb.description: Submitting this step creates or loads a persistent ADB identity for this Home Assistant installation and offers its public key to the Android panel at {address}. If the key is not already trusted, the panel should then show an authorization prompt. Physically approve it, then submit this step again to retry. Approval grants general ADB shell access while network debugging remains enabled; revoke it from the panel's developer settings. No APK is downloaded or installed at this step.

confirm_install_candidate.title: Install candidate found
confirm_install_candidate.description: The Android panel at {address} is reachable. Android Package Manager reports no installed or retained ha-paneld package; residual files on rooted panels are not checked yet. Device: model {model}; serial {serial}; ABI {abi}; Android SDK {sdk}. Stable release preview: version {version}; tag {tag}; SHA-256 {sha256}. This prototype only previews the candidate: it will not download the APK or install anything, and submitting it makes no panel changes.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to a valid ha-paneld health endpoint.
error.invalid_address: Enter a hostname or IP address without a URL scheme or path.
error.invalid_install_address: Enter only the panel hostname or IP address. The installer uses ha-paneld port 8888 and ADB port 5555 separately.
error.install_resolution_failed: Home Assistant could not resolve this panel address. Check the address and local DNS, then try again.
error.install_resolution_timeout: Local name resolution timed out before the panel address could be pinned safely. Check local DNS, then try again.
error.install_too_many_addresses: This hostname resolved to too many addresses to pin safely. Use a dedicated local hostname or private IP address.
error.unsafe_install_target: Installation is allowed only to a private local IPv4 address or a unique-local IPv6 address. No ADB connection was attempted.
error.install_target_changed: The hostname no longer resolves to the same pinned panel address. No ADB key or installation was sent. Check the address and start again.
error.adb_unreachable: ha-paneld did not respond and Android Debug Bridge (ADB) could not be reached. Check that the address is correct, the panel is online, and network debugging is enabled, then try again.
error.adb_unauthorized: The panel still requires ADB authorization. Approve the prompt on the panel, then try again.
error.adb_still_unauthorized: The panel has not accepted this Home Assistant instance yet. Approve the ADB prompt on the panel, then try again.
error.adb_credential_error: Home Assistant could not safely load or persist its ADB credential. No panel change was attempted. Check the Home Assistant storage and logs before retrying.
error.installed_without_health: The ha-paneld package is installed but its health endpoint did not respond. This flow will not overwrite or repair an unverified installation. Restore the existing installation or use a dedicated recovery workflow, then try again.
error.retained_or_ambiguous: The panel may contain a retained ha-paneld package record or its package state could not be proven absent. This flow refuses to continue to protect existing data. Inspect or recover the existing installation before trying again.
error.incompatible: The ha-paneld package was not found, but the panel's Android SDK or processor architecture is not supported. No APK was downloaded or installed.
error.cannot_resolve_release: An install candidate was found, but Home Assistant could not resolve and verify the current stable ha-paneld release. No APK was downloaded or installed. Check internet access and try again.

abort.prototype_ready: The install candidate and exact stable release were previewed. No APK was downloaded or installed, and no panel state changed.
abort.unknown: The setup flow lost its pending panel state. Start setup again.
